note: Freebie content for 'Make a freebie to give away'. Checklists are self-checks a buyer ticks; calculators run on numbers the buyer types; templates are fill-in pages. Defaults in calculators are starting guesses the buyer changes, not facts. No statistics, no claims about results.

detailing.title: The 20-Point Car Check
detailing.subject: your car

groups.name: Outside
items: Paint feels smooth when you run the back of your hand over it
Rough paint has stuck-on dirt that scratches when you wash
No bird droppings or tree sap left on the paint
They can mark the paint the longer they sit
Wheels are clean, with no brown brake dust
Brake dust bakes on and gets harder to remove
Headlights are clear, not foggy or yellow
Foggy lights are dimmer at night
Windows are streak-free inside and out
Streaks show up worst when you drive into the sun
Tires look dark, not gray or dusty
Clean tires make the whole car look newer

groups.name: Inside
items: Floor mats are clean under the driver's feet
That's where dirt grinds into the carpet
Seats have no stains or crumbs in the seams
Crumbs in seams mean the seats need a real vacuum
The car smells neutral when you first get in
A smell that comes back is in the seats or carpet
Cup holders and door pockets are clean
They're the stickiest spots in most cars
Dashboard and screens are dust-free
No pet hair on seats or carpet
Pet hair weaves into fabric and needs special tools
Trunk is clean and empty of old stuff
Seat belts are clean when you run a finger along them

groups.name: Habits
items: Washed in the last month
Inside cleaned in the last 3 months
You'd happily give a coworker a ride right now
The quickest honest test there is
Water beads up on the paint after rain
Beading means the paint still has protection
No chips or scratches you've been ignoring
Small chips grow when they're left alone
You know when the next clean is

bands: Your car is in great shape. Keep it up.
A few spots need attention before they get worse.
Time for a full reset, inside and out.

cleaning.title: The 20-Point Home Clean Check
cleaning.subject: your home

groups.name: Kitchen
items: Stovetop is free of baked-on spills
Inside the microwave is clean
Fridge shelves are wiped and nothing is past its date
Sink and drain smell fresh
A smell usually means buildup in the drain
Cabinet fronts and handles aren't sticky
Handles are touched more than anything else in the kitchen
Floor is clean along the edges and under the cabinets

groups.name: Bathrooms
items: No soap scum on the shower glass or tub
Grout looks like its real color
Toilet base and the floor behind it are clean
Mirror is streak-free
Towels smell fresh

groups.name: Whole home
items: Baseboards are dust-free
Ceiling fans and air vents aren't dusty
Dust up high falls on everything below
Under the couch and bed is clean
Light switches and door handles are wiped
Windowsills and window tracks are clean

groups.name: Habits
items: You clean on a set day each week
Nothing on the cleaning list has waited over a month
You could have guests over tomorrow without stress
The quickest honest test there is
You know which jobs you'd hand off first

bands: Your home is in great shape.
A few rooms need a reset.
Time for a deep clean, top to bottom.

lawn.title: The 15-Point Yard Check
lawn.subject: your yard

groups.name: Lawn
items: Grass is one even height, no long patches
Edges along walks and beds are sharp
Sharp edges make the whole yard look finished
No bare or brown spots bigger than your hand
Very few weeds in the lawn
Clippings and leaves are cleared off the grass
Leaves left on grass block the light it needs

groups.name: Beds and trees
items: Flower beds are weeded
Mulch is fresh and covers the soil
Bushes are trimmed back from the house
No branches touch the roof
Dead plants are pulled out

groups.name: This season
items: Fallen leaves have a plan
Gutters were cleared after the leaves fell
Hoses and outside taps are ready for cold weather
You know what the yard needs next season
The yard looks the way you want from the street
The quickest honest test there is

bands: Your yard is in great shape.
A few jobs to get done this season.
Time for a full cleanup.

washing.title: The 12-Point Curb Appeal Check
washing.subject: the outside of your home

groups.name: Walls and roofline
items: Siding has no green or black streaks
Green usually means algae or mildew
No cobwebs under the eaves
Brick and stone look like their real color
Gutters are clean on the outside

groups.name: Ground
items: Driveway has no dark oil or tire marks
Sidewalk is one color, not blotchy
Patio or deck isn't slippery or green
Green surfaces get slippery when wet
Front steps and entry are clean
It's the first thing guests see up close

groups.name: Extras
items: Fence is clean and even in color
Windows are clean from the outside
Outdoor furniture is clean enough to sit on
The trash bin area is clean and doesn't smell

bands: Your home looks great from the curb.
A few spots need a wash.
Time for a full wash, top to bottom.

petcare.title: The 12-Point Happy Dog Check
petcare.subject: your dog's week

groups.name: Exercise
items: Gets a walk on workdays, not only weekends
Gets time to sniff and explore on walks
Sniffing is how dogs take in the world
Has burned some energy before you leave for the day
Stays calm, not destructive, when left alone

groups.name: Routine
items: Eats and goes out on a steady schedule
The water bowl is always full
Has a safe, comfy spot to rest
Nails are trimmed (no clicking on the floor)

groups.name: Backup plan
items: Someone can let your dog out if you're running late
There's a plan for trips and long days
A sitter would find the food, meds and vet info in one place
Your dog is comfortable with new people

bands: Your dog has a great setup.
A few gaps, mostly on busy days.
Time for a backup plan you can count on.

photo.title: The 12-Point Photo Check
photo.subject: your photos online

groups.name: First look
items: Your Google listing has photos from the last 3 months
The first photo people see shows your best work or space
Photos are bright and sharp, not dark or blurry
There's a photo of you or your team
People like to know who they'll meet

groups.name: Consistency
items: Photos look like one brand, with the same feel
Your website uses your own photos, not stock photos
Your last 9 posts look good side by side
Menu or product photos match what people actually get

groups.name: Ready to use
items: You have photos ready for holidays and promos
Photos show people enjoying the place or product
Every photo has a reason to be there
You'd be proud to show any of them to a new customer
The quickest honest test there is

bands: Your photos are working for you.
A few gaps to fill.
Time for a fresh set of photos.

fitness.title: The 12-Point Starting Point Check
fitness.subject: where you're starting

groups.name: Everyday strength
items: You can climb two flights of stairs without stopping
You can get up off the floor easily
You carry the groceries in one trip
You walk most days

groups.name: Habits
items: You move on purpose 3 or more days a week
You know what to do when you walk into a gym
You sleep well most nights
You drink water through the day

groups.name: Plan
items: You have a goal for the next 30 days
Someone checks in on your progress
Having someone expect you makes it easier to show up
You know your starting numbers
Write them down today so you can see change later
You've kept a routine going for a month before

bands: Strong base. Time for a real plan.
Good start. A written plan makes the next step clear.
A great time to start, with someone in your corner.

tutoring.title: The 12-Point Homework and Test Check
tutoring.subject: your child's school week

groups.name: Homework
items: Homework starts without a fight
Your child knows where to find every assignment
Homework is done before the evening is over
They ask for help when they're stuck

groups.name: Tests
items: Test dates are on a calendar at home
Studying starts 3 or more days before a test
A few short sessions are easier than one long night
They can explain what the next test covers
They feel okay, not panicked, before a test

groups.name: Progress
items: You know their current grade in each class
Missing work gets caught within a week
Their teacher would say they're keeping up
There's a plan for their hardest subject

bands: School is running smoothly.
A few gaps, usually in one subject.
Time for a plan and some help.

web.title: The 15-Point Website Check
web.subject: your website

groups.name: First look on a phone
items: It opens fast on your phone
A slow page loses people before they see anything
The first line says what you do and where
There's a call or book button you can tap with your thumb
Text is big enough to read without zooming
It shows a real photo of your work or place

groups.name: Trust
items: The year in the footer is this year
An old year makes people wonder if you're still open
Prices, or a starting price, are on the page
Your hours and service area are easy to find
Real reviews are shown or linked
Your phone and address match your Google listing

groups.name: Getting found
items: It shows up when you search your business name
Each page has its own title
It works on every phone you've tried
People can book or message without calling
You can update it yourself, or you know who will

bands: Your site is in good shape.
A few fixes would make it work harder for you.
Time for a new site.

social.title: The 15-Point Instagram Check
social.subject: your Instagram

groups.name: Profile
items: Your bio says what you do and where
The link goes somewhere useful
Your profile photo is clear even when it's tiny
Highlights show prices, work and reviews
The contact button works

groups.name: Posts
items: You posted in the last 7 days
A quiet account makes people wonder if you're open
Your last 9 posts show your real work or place
There's at least one short video from the last month
Captions tell people what to do next
Posts show faces, not only products

groups.name: Habits
items: Comments get a reply within a day
DMs get a reply within a day
You know which post did best last month
There's a plan for next week's posts
Someone else could post if you're busy

bands: Your account is in good shape.
A few gaps to close.
Time for a plan and some help posting.

video.title: The 12-Point Video Check
video.subject: your videos

groups.name: Basics
items: You posted a video in the last 14 days
The first 2 seconds show a face or something moving
Your videos have captions on screen
Captions help anyone watching with the sound off
They're filmed upright for phones

groups.name: Message
items: Sound is clear, without background noise
Each video has one clear message
The last frame says what to do next
You have clips of your real place or product

groups.name: Plan
items: You know your best video from last month
There's a plan for next month's videos
You have someone to film or edit
Your videos look like one brand

bands: Your videos are in good shape.
A few fixes would make them work harder.
Time for a video plan and some help.

candles.title: The 12-Point Candle Care Check
candles.subject: your candles

groups.name: Burning
items: You trim the wick before each burn
A short wick burns cleaner
The first burn lasts until the melted wax reaches the edges
That keeps it from tunneling
Candles burn away from drafts and vents
You stop each burn after a few hours

groups.name: Scent
items: Your scents match the season
Each room has a scent that suits it
You know which scents you'd give as gifts
You keep one ready for when guests come over

groups.name: Safety
items: Candles sit on a heat-safe surface
They're out of reach of pets and kids
You never leave one burning in an empty room
Empty jars get cleaned and reused or recycled

bands: You're a candle pro.
A few habits to change for a cleaner burn.
Time for a fresh start, and better candles.

home.title: The 12-Point Home Check
home.subject: your home

groups.name: Outside
items: Gutters are clear and water flows away from the house
Walkways and steps are clean and not slippery
All the outside lights work
Windows and screens are clean and not torn

groups.name: Inside
items: The air filter was changed this season
Smoke alarms beep when you press test
No drips under the sinks
Every room has a place for things

groups.name: Upkeep
items: You know when each job was last done
There's a plan for the next big job
Nothing you're putting off is getting worse
Someone you trust can do the jobs you don't want to

bands: Your home is in great shape.
A few jobs to schedule.
Time to get help with the big ones.

personal.title: The 10-Point Look Check
personal.subject: your look

groups.name: Know what you want
items: You've saved 2 or 3 photos of the look you want
You know what you didn't like last time
You know how much time you'll spend on it each morning
You know your budget for keeping it up

groups.name: Keep it up
items: You have the right products at home
You know how to style it on a busy day
Your next appointment is already booked
Booking ahead gets you the times you want

groups.name: Feel good
items: You like what you see in the mirror today
The quickest honest test there is
You'd be happy to be in a photo right now
You feel like yourself, only sharper

bands: You're all set.
A few things to plan before your next visit.
Time for a fresh look and a plan to keep it.

teach.title: The 12-Point Progress Check
teach.subject: your progress

groups.name: Goal
items: You have one clear goal for the next 30 days
You know why it matters to you
You know your starting point
Write it down today so you can see the change later
You know the next step after this one

groups.name: Practice
items: You practice on set days
You track what you did
You know what to work on between lessons
You have a plan for busy weeks

groups.name: Support
items: Someone checks your progress
You get feedback on what to fix
You've kept a routine for a month before
You know what's been holding you back

bands: You're set up to keep going.
A plan and a check-in would help.
A great time to start with a coach.

b2b.title: The 12-Point Busy Owner Check
b2b.subject: your business

groups.name: Getting found
items: Your Google listing shows your current hours
Your website works on a phone
You posted on social media in the last 7 days
People can book or ask a question without calling

groups.name: Answering
items: Calls get answered or returned the same day
Messages get a reply within a day
You follow up with people who asked but didn't buy
Your prices are written down where customers can see them

groups.name: Time
items: You ask every customer for an honest review
You know where your last 10 customers came from
You have one hour a week to work on the business, not in it
The jobs you hate have someone to hand them to

bands: Your business runs smoothly.
A few gaps are costing you time.
Time to hand some of this off.

product.title: The 10-Point Gift Check
product.subject: your gift list

groups.name: The list
items: You have a list of everyone you're buying for
There's a budget for each person
You know what each person already loves
You've picked something for the hard-to-shop-for person

groups.name: Timing
items: Gifts that ship are ordered with time to spare
You have a few small extras for surprise guests
Wrapping and cards are ready

groups.name: Feel good
items: Most gifts are from small makers, not big chains
Each gift has a note that says why you picked it
You're not stressed about it
The quickest honest test there is

bands: You're ready.
A few gifts left to sort.
Time to start the list.

digital.title: The 10-Point Weekly Time Check
digital.subject: your week

groups.name: Plan
items: You know where your hours go each week
Your to-do list lives in one place
You plan your week before Monday

groups.name: Repeat jobs
items: Jobs you repeat have a checklist or template
Files are named so you can find them fast
You do similar tasks together, in one block
You have a ready reply for common questions

groups.name: Done
items: Your inbox is under control
You end the week knowing what's next
You have one evening a week with nothing to do

bands: Your week runs itself.
A few systems would save you hours.
Time to set up a system.

food.title: The 10-Point Party Food Check
food.subject: your party food

groups.name: Plan
items: You know your guest count
You know about any allergies
There's something for kids and something not sweet
You know how much to order
The planner on the next page does the math

groups.name: Timing
items: Treats are ordered at least a few days ahead
You know when to pick up or when it arrives
You have a plan to keep food fresh

groups.name: Serving
items: Plates, napkins and a knife are ready
There's a spot on the table for the centerpiece treat
Someone's in charge of serving

bands: You're ready to host.
A few things left to sort.
Let's plan it together.
